title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Four no-admission outings with clearly documented access near Gustavus Adolphus College.

cards.entity_name: Seven Mile Creek Park trail outing
cards.title: Cross the Creek Footbridges
cards.subtitle: A sunrise-to-sunset group trail outing
cards.notes: Coordinate transportation south of Saint Peter, choose a turnaround point together, and finish before the county park closes at sunset.
cards.short_summary: Follow multiuse trails and footbridges through the 628-acre county park.
cards.evidence_claim: Nicollet County says Seven Mile Creek Park has multiuse trails and several footbridges, operates sunrise to sunset, and cannot be reserved.
cards.access_notes: Public county park; open from sunrise until sunset. Transportation from Saint Peter is required.

cards.entity_name: Seven Mile Creek Park volleyball courts
cards.title: Bring a Ball for Volleyball
cards.subtitle: Two first-come, first-served courts
cards.notes: Gather a group, bring your own volleyball, and check the park supervisor’s event calendar if you want to reduce the chance of a conflict.
cards.short_summary: Organize a casual match on one of the county park’s two courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Nicollet County documents two volleyball courts at Seven Mile Creek Park and says the park is first come, first served rather than reservable.
cards.access_notes: Public county park; open sunrise to sunset. Bring any ball or other equipment needed for play.

cards.title: Meet Up at Gault Park
cards.subtitle: Play structures and open sports space
cards.notes: Pick the play structures or an unscheduled field as your meeting point, bring any game equipment, and yield to posted or organized field use.
cards.short_summary: Use a neighborhood park built around play and field activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Peter identifies Gault Park as a neighborhood sports complex with soccer and softball fields, play structures, drinking fountains, and restrooms.
cards.access_notes: Public city park; city hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Scheduled-field restrictions and posted park rules apply.

cards.title: Walk Community Spirit Park
cards.subtitle: A public loop around a sports complex
cards.notes: Meet beside the walking trails, set a shared number of loops, and steer around games or practices that may be using adjacent fields.
cards.short_summary: Turn the city-listed walking option into an easy group catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Peter expressly invites visitors to walk at Community Spirit Park and identifies it as a large outdoor sports complex beside the high school.
cards.access_notes: Public city park; city hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m. School activities and scheduled sports may affect availability.

warnings: Only four defensible subjects remained after excluding the Arboretum trails and close aliases. Additional candidates lacked direct evidence of no-cost access, were temporary events, or could not support the required visual-documentation standard.
